ItemName: Group Photo of March 7th and Friends
ItemDesc: After using it in your Inventory, you can view the group photo.
ItemBGDesc: The group photo taken after March 7th won the Best Newcomer Award at the photography exhibition, with friends that helped during the exhibition specially invited to appear.\n\n"The journey freezes into moments, moments weave into memories, and memories tell a story... The trailblazing expedition continues, and the story will not end here."
